description: Verified review brief for ANY pull request (not just your own): what changed grouped by area/risk, CI triage with the base-vs-head classifier, review findings classified real vs false-positive with evidence, test evidence present or explicitly absent, merge-readiness blockers (conflicts, unresolved change requests, missing changesets), ending with a one-line look-at-this-first. Deterministic classifiers only; unverified items are marked as such.

target.description: PR URL or owner/repo#N, e.g. https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9569 or usebruno/bruno#9569

name: pr_brief
